subject: Independent integration handoff: current stable semantic gates, real producer priority
body:
Welcome. Please read frontend_audit_004_integration_gates.md INCLUDING its superseding section, and the new frontend_audit_005_integration_test_brief.md. Earlier table3/8-byte-manifest complaints are now superseded: source has common n2t helpers, table1/2 and 128-byte header/64-byte manifest. These are structural progress, not a final schema ACK. Production is moving; record SHA256 and test real producer snapshots, do not copy implementations into test formulas.
Priority complete selector7 job: v2 currently never initializes SHADER_PROGRAM/LOCAL_STORAGE at command+128/+192; package vs wire FAU count inconsistent. Actual descriptors should be decoded via pinned arch9 Mesa oracle; fake completion alone does not prove this. Additional newly observed cases are native sampler binding31/255 (currently mistaken limit16), Metal slot30 -> native buffer0, 1D-array shape, ordinarycube shape, nonzero BO subrange offset, full array/cube plane payloads, NULL helper layout, oversized render request binding_count. I am posting exact owner findings separately. C/Rust region/dispatch sizeof/offsetof and serialization must use actual declarations, not only Rust assertions. Manifest domains still require compute/lowering agreement; tests should flag unknown enums/unsupported combinations explicitly until that ACK.
Graphics specialized compiler source and frozen host library have owner 66/66 +58/58+10/10 tests, but this does not prove frontend bound variants/cache lifetime. Keep nearest/linear/nearest queued draws plus eviction/early app release, and Vulkan immutable-enum conversion distinct from Metal sampler state. No need to duplicate the source-only audit; executable minimal repro/producer decode is your useful independent evidence.
